_note: Composition B — curation-and-craft led. Centered hero with sourcing stats, about-us with the owners' voice, cards-grid product categories, banner CTA with store info.

data.title: The cannabis shop your friend who knows wine would recommend
data.subtitle: We curate every product on the shelf the way a sommelier curates a wine list — direct relationships with growers, tasting before we stock, and budtenders who can talk lineage as easily as effect.

data.title: Every product is chosen by someone whose name is on the door
data.subtitle: Most dispensaries take whatever the distributor offers. We don't. The owners pick every strain, taste every edible, and pull anything off the shelf that doesn't hold up.

data.heading: Four categories, all curated
data.intro: We refresh the menu weekly and rotate cultivators monthly — the shelves always read like the best of what's growing right now.

items.title: Flower
items.description: Indica, sativa, hybrid from small Wisconsin/Illinois/Michigan cultivators. 12–18 strains in rotation.

items.title: Edibles
items.description: Chocolate, gummies, beverages, baked goods. Microdose to 100mg. Vegan + GF options.

items.title: Concentrates
items.description: Live rosin, hash, distillate carts. Full COA posted at the register for every batch.

items.title: Accessories
items.description: Hand-blown glass from regional artists, premium grinders, storage, papers.

data.heading: Come see us
data.subtitle: Open daily 10am–9pm. 21+ recreational and registered medical patients welcome. First-time visitor? Just ask — we'll take care of you.
